2xs.$description: 2px: a value and its unit, a label and its value in a Stat.

xs.$description: 4px: lines in a group (a title and its detail); a list's padding above and below.

sm.$description: 6px: items in a row (an icon and its label, a dot and its word).

md.$description: 8px: an icon and a row's text; controls side by side; the default Stack gap.

lg.$description: 12px: the window inset (--inset); between groups of a toolbar or status line.

xl.$description: 16px: between sections of a list or inspector; between columns of a table (2 × 8).

2xl.$description: 24px: between a dashboard's panes; above a document's column.

3xl.$description: 32px: below a document's column. Rarely anything else.

inset.$description: A window's content inset, on every side, measured to the letters: a padded body, the first and last table column, list rows' content, footer text. One value for every window.

measure.$description: Reading width for prose: a document's column (Measure).

w.$description: How wide a page of settings rows grows (the Settings window): rows keep their label and control within reach in a wide window; the page centres past it.
